text: Ladies and gentlemen, from the charcoal corner, standing one point seven nine meters of buzz cut, stubble and white hand wraps, here comes the Seamstress of Steel! This time he brought a clean, honest polish pass, leveling the shorts hem and softening that shoulder collar lip. The realism score holds right at 60, same as last time. Homework, champ: that jagged yoke patch under the neckline and those lumpy shorts up front. Approved and ready to rumble, give it up for the one and only GROK!
